COMMERCIAL GENERAL LIABILITY COVERAGE FORM (SYNTHETIC, FOR DEMONSTRATION ONLY) — 2025 REVISION

SECTION I — INSURING AGREEMENTS

1. Coverage A — Bodily Injury and Property Damage Liability
We will pay those sums that the insured becomes legally obligated to pay as damages because of "bodily injury" or "property damage" to which this insurance applies. We will have the right and duty to defend the insured against any "suit" seeking those damages.

SECTION II — EXCLUSIONS

2. Exclusion — Expected or Intended Injury
This insurance does not apply to "bodily injury" or "property damage" expected or intended from the standpoint of the insured.

3. Exclusion — Contractual Liability
This insurance does not apply to "bodily injury" or "property damage" for which the insured is obligated to pay damages by reason of the assumption of liability in a contract or agreement, except with respect to liability assumed under an "insured contract".

4. Exclusion — Pollution
This insurance does not apply to "bodily injury" or "property damage" arising out of the actual, alleged or threatened discharge, dispersal, seepage, migration, release or defect of pollutants, or arising out of the actual or alleged presence of fungi or bacteria.

5. Exclusion — Cyber Incident
This insurance does not apply to "bodily injury" or "property damage" arising out of any actual or alleged access to or disclosure of any person's confidential information, or arising out of any electronic data breach or cyber incident.

SECTION III — SUPPLEMENTARY PAYMENTS

6. Supplementary Payments — General
With respect to any claim we investigate or settle, we will pay all costs we incur and premiums on appeal bonds.

SECTION IV — LIMITS OF INSURANCE

7. Each Occurrence Limit
The Each Occurrence Limit is $2,000,000, subject to the General Aggregate Limit shown below.

8. General Aggregate Limit
The General Aggregate Limit is $1,500,000 and is the most we will pay for the sum of all damages under Coverage A regardless of the number of insureds, claims made or suits brought.

9. Fire Legal Liability Limit
The Fire Legal Liability Limit is $100,000 for damages because of "property damage" to premises rented to the named insured arising out of any one fire.

SECTION V — DEDUCTIBLE

10. Property Damage Deductible
A deductible of $2,500 per occurrence applies to each claim for "property damage" before we make any payment under this policy.

SECTION VI — DEFINITIONS

11. "Occurrence" means an accident, including continuous or repeated exposure to substantially the same general harmful conditions.

12. "Bodily injury" means bodily injury, sickness or disease sustained by a person, including death resulting from any of these at any time.

13. "Property damage" means physical injury to tangible property, including all resulting loss of use of that property, and also includes loss of use of tangible property that is not physically injured.

14. "Insured" means the named insured shown in the declarations, and any partner or executive officer while acting within the scope of duties.

SECTION VII — CONDITIONS

15. Other Insurance
If other valid and collectible insurance is available for a loss we cover, our obligations are limited as described in this condition.

16. Duties in the Event of Occurrence
The insured must give written notice of an "occurrence" to us within 30 days after the occurrence becomes known to any insured's management.
